Does local SEO still work in 2026?

Ava Digital · Updated 2026 · ~4 min read
Short answer: Yes — arguably more than ever. As search shifts to “near me” and AI-generated answers, local signals (Google Business Profile, reviews, local content) decide who gets shown. For a small business, local SEO is still one of the highest-ROI channels.

Why some think it’s dead

Ads and the map pack push organic results down, and AI answers sit on top. It looks crowded — but local intent is bigger than ever, and AI answers still pull from local sources.

Why it still works

  • “Near me” searches keep rising — and they convert.
  • AI results cite local sources — a well-optimized profile and content get referenced.
  • Less competition — ranking in one city is far easier than ranking nationally.

What matters most now

A complete Google Business Profile, a steady flow of reviews, genuinely local content, and consistent business info across the web. Do those well and you win the searches happening in your own backyard.
